paragraph: Midland Park is a single-family town, plain and simple. Twenty-seven houses sold over six months at a median of $788,888, with one lone condo sale in the whole window, so there is no real second tier to compare. The numbers point one direction: a sale-to-list ratio of 1.07, about 70 percent of homes selling above asking, and a median of 13 days on market. That is a real seller's market with plenty of multiple offer situations. Sales ran from $460,000 to $1,271,000, so the median is the better guide than the edges. The early months are too thin to read, but volume built to seven closings in June and nine in July with medians of $810,000 and $825,000, which tracks the normal Bergen County summer peak. If the usual pattern holds, expect closings and medians to ease as fall arrives. As a buyer here, you should be prepared to move fast and compete.
